detailed_description:
The target video uses a 3D CGI plush-toy cinematic style with warm yellow pendant lamp light, soft shadows, a cozy home dining room with large windows showing a night city view, and shallow depth of field.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot establishes the dining room matching <Picture 3>. <Subject 1>, the brown-and-cream plush monster man, sits at a wooden table loaded with steaming home-cooked dishes (tomato scrambled eggs, braised pork, potato stew, green vegetables, soup, rice bowls), looking serious and exasperated. <Subject 2>, the green lotus-bud plush dragon woman, sits across from him looking upset.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>, who leans forward slightly. His low middle-aged male voice, weary and irritated (S1), says: <d>[Chinese] 我做了一桌子的菜，你在闹什么？</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:05.430, the camera cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2>, her eyes glistening. Her high young female voice, hurt and pleading (S2), says: <d>[Chinese] 我说我想吃鱼，说了好久了。</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:09.270, the camera cuts back to a close-up of <Subject 1>, whose expression shifts to helpless resignation. The same voice (S1), now defensive and tired, says: <d>[Chinese] 我白天去钓了啊，这不是没钓到吗？</d> He looks down briefly.

A quiet domestic ambience with a distant refrigerator hum and the faint clink of ceramic bowls. Steam rises from the dishes with a soft sizzle. The man's chair creaks slightly as he leans forward.
